rooms.name: B1F Ballroom Prominence - Entire Room
rooms.note: The official description gives an area of 1,565㎡ (I+II+III), while the spec table gives 1,892㎡ for the entire room. The June 2022 PDF gives 1,892㎡ for the entire room and 1,565㎡ for I+II+III, and its banquet setup example is 810 guests (the table says 870). A standing reception combining the medium banquet rooms and the lobby is described as up to 3,000 guests (about 3,200㎡).

ops.loadingHours: There are 2 loading lifts beside the B1F ballroom "Prominence"; the floor plan marks them as for 4-ton and 2-ton trucks. The corridor before and after the lifts is marked "ceiling height 2.35 m". (Source: B1F floor plan)
ops.parking: There is a parking lot for 500 cars on the B2 and B3 floors, open 24 hours with no reservation needed. Vehicles up to 6 m long, 2.5 m wide, 2.1 m high and 3 t in weight can be accommodated. The regular rate is 200 yen per 10 minutes (maximum 4,400 yen per day). For wedding, banquet and meeting use, parking is free for up to 4 hours, and time beyond that is charged at the regular rate.
ops.waitingRooms: The 1F small banquet rooms (33 to 85㎡, 9 rooms) are described as usable as waiting rooms or secretariat rooms for seminars, parties and similar events. The 1F small banquet room floor plan also carries a "Waiting Room" label. (Source: Banquet Guide March 2025 edition, 1F floor plan)
ops.restaurants: The official restaurant & bar list shows 13 venues (Le Petit Chef [limited time], Cascade Cafe, Atrium Lounge, Teppanyaki "Akasaka", MIXX Bar & Lounge, The Steakhouse, Japanese restaurant "Unkai", Chinese restaurant "Karin", Main Bar "Da Vinci", Brewers Coffee & Bar, Geneva Lobby Bar, Passage Gourmand, Sushi "Kenzan"). Seat counts in the fact sheet (March 2025) are: Unkai 120 seats and 8 private rooms, Karin 188 seats and 7 private rooms, The Steakhouse 108 seats and 4 private rooms, Cascade Cafe 162 seats, Atrium Lounge 142 seats. For receptions, there are an exclusive-use banquet plan at the Japanese restaurant "Unkai" (2 to 60 guests; for 25 to 60 guests, all or half of the general seating is reserved exclusively; private room and exclusive-use fees are extra) and the InterContinental Party Plan, usable in banquet rooms other than Prominence (20 to 100 guests, 2 hours, from 12,000 yen per person, April 2026 to March 2027).
